set -euo pipefail

WORKER_IP="<worker-rdma-ip>"
RDMA_IFACE="<rdma-interface>"
GID_INDEX=3
IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1

VLLM_CACHE_HOST="<vllm-cache-path>"
FLASHINFER_CACHE_HOST="<flashinfer-cache-path>"
TRITON_CACHE_HOST="<triton-cache-path>"
NODE_ROLE="<head-or-worker>"

  awk -F, '$2 ~ /GB300/ {gsub(/ /,"",$1); print $1; exit}')
test -n "$GPU_UUID"
test -f "$MODEL_HOST/config.json"

for HCA in mlx5_0 mlx5_1; do
  test "$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$HCA/ports/1/gid_attrs/types/$GID_INDEX)" = 'RoCE v2'
  cat /sys/class/infiniband/$HCA/ports/1/gid_attrs/ndevs/$GID_INDEX

case "$NODE_ROLE" in
  head)
    NODE_IP=$HEAD_IP
    PEER_IP=$WORKER_IP
    ;;
  worker)
    NODE_IP=$WORKER_IP
    PEER_IP=$HEAD_IP
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Set NODE_ROLE to head or worker" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

ip -4 -br addr show dev "$RDMA_IFACE"
ping -c 2 -W 2 "$PEER_IP"

  --ipc=host --network host --shm-size 64g \

prerequisites: DGX Station GB300 with 494 GiB host memory and swap enabled; measured startup and serving used up to about 107 GiB of swap (193 GiB configured).
Space for 510 GB (475 GiB) of weights under ~/.cache/huggingface, plus container and compilation caches.
Docker with NVIDIA GPU passthrough; sudo for drop_caches before each start.
limitations: Selected for decode throughput at 1 to 4 users with --max-num-seqs 8 and --max-model-len 40960, text only. KV cache is 6.08 GiB (361730 tokens, 8.8 full-length contexts); eight concurrent full-length contexts were not tested.
Coding TTFT p50 is 0.65 s at 1 user and 0.35 s at 4 users. One run per point; no repeated-run variance study.

DSpark speculative decoding was not validated on this image. On the earlier 2026-09-16 nightly, DSpark at 80 GiB offload with 4096 batched tokens reached 89.7 tok/s per user on coding and 68.2 on the 32K-prefix shape at 1 user.

Startup took about 9 minutes with weights on local disk, with MemAvailable at least 83 GiB and swap peaking at about 107 GiB. Cold and warm startup were not isolated; the Docker and drop_caches setup was not exercised verbatim. Earlier builds encountered nvidia_uvm kernel Oops under offload; this run recorded none.

runtime.label: Container (ARM64)
runtime.setup_instructions: Run in Bash on a DGX Station GB300 with 494 GiB host memory; startup used about 186 GiB of swap. Allow 510 GB for weights plus container and compilation caches; sudo is required to drop the page cache before launch.
runtime.setup_command:
GPU_UUID=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=uuid,name --format=csv,noheader | \
  awk -F, '$2 ~ /GB300/ {gsub(/ /,"",$1); print $1; exit}')
: "${GPU_UUID:?no GB300 found}"

docker run --rm \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  --entrypoint hf \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0-aarch64 \
  download deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --revision dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277 --local-dir /root/.cache/huggingface/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash &&
sudo sh -c 'sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches' &&

docker run --rm -it \
  --gpus device="${GPU_UUID:?no GB300 found}" \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 \
  -e VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -v ~/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm \
  -v ~/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer \

  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \

  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --max-model-len 40960 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.97 \
  --language-model-only \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --cpu-offload-gb 48 \
  --kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune": false}'

# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export NODE_RANK="<0-1>"
export IMAGE="eugr/spark-vllm:latest"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \

  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \

  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
  -e NODE_RANK="$NODE_RANK" \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \

  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \

runtime.label: ARM64 container with pinned warmup backport
runtime.setup_instructions: Run in Bash on both nodes after exporting the required role-specific variables. MODEL_ROOT must be the local Hugging Face cache root containing the checkpoint. Setup downloads and checksum-verifies the pinned warmup patch from GitHub.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail

: "${ROLE:?set ROLE to head or worker}"
: "${HEAD_IP:?set HEAD_IP to the head-node ConnectX-8 address}"
: "${WORKER_IP:?set WORKER_IP to the worker-node ConnectX-8 address}"
: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE:?set NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE to the bootstrap interface}"
: "${GPU_UUID:?set GPU_UUID to the local GB300 UUID}"
: "${MODEL_ROOT:?set MODEL_ROOT to the local Hugging Face cache root}"

CTR=nemo-ray
IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.25.1-aarch64
MODEL=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4
RAY_VERSION=2.56.0
AIPERF_VERSION=0.11.0
VLLM_WARMUP_PATCH_SHA256=e9f181d3b6957fccad0f92c270caa0e6a32277de6a0b62ec43788aafe4f6c701

PATCH=$(mktemp /tmp/vllm-pr48363.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$PATCH"' EXIT
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 \
  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c65ba6aa8ffe9fa6719c5dcdda747b59d7d32520.patch \
  -o "$PATCH"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$VLLM_WARMUP_PATCH_SHA256" "$PATCH" | sha256sum -c -

case "$ROLE" in
  head) VLLM_HOST_IP=$HEAD_IP ;;
  worker) VLLM_HOST_IP=$WORKER_IP ;;
  *) echo 'ROLE must be head or worker' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

test -d "$MODEL_ROOT/hub/models--nvidia--NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,uuid --format=csv,noheader | grep -F 'NVIDIA GB300'
for HCA in mlx5_0 mlx5_1; do
  NDEV=$(cat "/sys/class/infiniband/$HCA/ports/1/gid_attrs/ndevs/3")
  echo "$HCA -> $NDEV"
done

docker run -d --name "$CTR" --network host --shm-size 16g \
  --gpus device="$GPU_UUID" \
  --device=/dev/infiniband/uverbs0 --device=/dev/infiniband/uverbs1 --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  -e VLLM_HOST_IP="$VLLM_HOST_IP" \
  -e VLLM_USE_RAY_V2_EXECUTOR_BACKEND=1 \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0,mlx5_1 -e NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 -e NCCL_IB_TC=106 \
  -e NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=PHB -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$NCCL_SOCKET_IFACE" \
  -e NCCL_IB_QPS_PER_CONNECTION=4 -e NCCL_IB_PCI_RELAXED_ORDERING=1 \
  -e HF_HOME=/models/huggingface \
  -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  -v "$MODEL_ROOT:/models/huggingface" \
  --entrypoint sleep "$IMG" infinity

docker exec "$CTR" pip install --break-system-packages "ray==$RAY_VERSION"
docker exec "$CTR" python3 -c \
  "import ray; assert ray.__version__ == '$RAY_VERSION'; print('ray', ray.__version__)"

if test "$ROLE" = head; then
  docker exec "$CTR" pip install --break-system-packages --ignore-installed \
    'blinker==1.9.0' "aiperf==$AIPERF_VERSION"
  docker exec "$CTR" python3 -c \
    "import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('aiperf') == '$AIPERF_VERSION'; print('aiperf='+m.version('aiperf'))"
fi

docker cp "$PATCH" "$CTR":/tmp/vllm-pr48363.patch
docker exec "$CTR" bash -c '
  set -euo pipefail
  SITE=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages
  patch --batch --forward --fuzz=0 --dry-run -d "$SITE" -p1 \
    < /tmp/vllm-pr48363.patch
  patch --batch --forward --fuzz=0 -d "$SITE" -p1 \
    < /tmp/vllm-pr48363.patch
'
docker exec "$CTR" python3 -c \
  "from vllm.model_executor.warmup.hybrid_mamba_warmup import hybrid_mamba_triton_warmup; print('PR48363_READY')"

serve.label: Start PP2 head
serve.instructions: Start this head command and then run the worker command on the second node. The head waits for both Ray GPUs before launching vLLM.
serve.command:
set -euo pipefail

: "${HEAD_IP:?set HEAD_IP to the head-node ConnectX-8 address}"
CTR=nemo-ray
MODEL=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4

docker exec -d "$CTR" ray start --head \
  --node-ip-address="$HEAD_IP" --port=6379 --num-gpus=1 --block

for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  docker exec "$CTR" ray status 2>/dev/null | grep -F '2.0 GPU' && break
  sleep 2
done
docker exec "$CTR" ray status | grep -F '2.0 GPU'

docker exec -d "$CTR" bash -c "
  exec env VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600 \
    vllm serve '$MODEL' \
    --served-model-name nemotron-ultra --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 --pipeline-parallel-size 2 --distributed-executor-backend ray \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 40960 --enable-prefix-caching \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --max-num-seqs 256 \
    --distributed-timeout-seconds 600 \
    > /tmp/vllm_serve.log 2>&1
"

HEALTHY=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if docker exec "$CTR" curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health \
      >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo 'vLLM READY'
    HEALTHY=1
    break
  fi
  if ! docker exec "$CTR" pgrep -f '[v]llm serve' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker exec "$CTR" tail -n 100 /tmp/vllm_serve.log
    echo 'vLLM exited during startup' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 10
done
if test "$HEALTHY" != 1; then
  docker exec "$CTR" tail -n 100 /tmp/vllm_serve.log
  echo 'vLLM health check timed out' >&2
  exit 1
fi

runtime.label: Container
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on every node after setting `HF_TOKEN`; replace the node-specific placeholders.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export NODE_RANK="<0-1>"
export IMAGE="vllm/vllm-openai:v0.28.0"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
  -e NODE_RANK="$NODE_RANK" \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \

runtime.label: Container (community, mutable, ARM64, custom B12x)
runtime.setup_instructions: Run on every node after setting `HF_TOKEN`; replace the node-specific placeholders.
runtime.setup_command:
# Example two-Spark values (adjust to your network):
#   HEAD_IP="10.100.32.1"        # head node IP on the ETH subnet
#   ETH_IF="enp1s0f0np0"        # ConnectX baseboard ethernet (socket/control)
#   IB_IF="rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0"   # RoCE HCA names (data plane) - use both "twins"!
export HEAD_IP="<head-connectx-ip>"
export ETH_IF="<connectx-interface>"
export IB_IF="<roce-interface-1>,<roce-interface-2>"
export MASTER_PORT=29501
export IMAGE="eugr/spark-vllm-b12x:latest"
export HF_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/huggingface"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE_DIR" "$HOME/.cache/vllm" "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer" "$HOME/.triton" "$HOME/.cache/b12x"

docker run --rm -it \
  --privileged \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit nofile=1048576:1048576 \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -e MN_IF_NAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e UCX_NET_DEVICES="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_HCA="$IB_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 \
  -e OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include="$ETH_IF" \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e TP_SOCKET_IFNAME="$ETH_IF" \
  -e NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 \
  -e HEAD_IP="$HEAD_IP" \
  -e MASTER_PORT="$MASTER_PORT" \
  -v "$HF_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/huggingface" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/vllm:/root/.cache/vllm" \
  -v "$HOME/.cache/flashinfer:/root/.cache/flashinfer" \
  -v "$HOME/.triton:/root/.triton" \
  -v $HOME/.cache/b12x:/root/.cache/b12x \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  "$IMAGE"

runtime.label: Container (ARM64)
runtime.setup_instructions: Use Bash and replace every placeholder. Set `NTP_HOST` only when the NTP route needs correction. Start it on the worker with `NODE_ROLE=worker`; the worker waits up to six hours for the replicated checkpoint unless `MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` is overridden. Then run it on the head with `NODE_ROLE=head`; the head downloads and replicates the checkpoint. Passwordless SSH to the worker RoCE address is required.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail

HEAD_IP="<head-roce-ip>"
WORKER_IP="<worker-roce-ip>"
RAIL_IFACE="<roce-interface>"
RAIL_HCA="<roce-hca>"

IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.25.1-aarch64
MODEL_REPO=nvidia/GLM-5.2-NVFP4
MODEL_REV=aec724e8c7b8ee9db3b48c01c320f63f9cdaf8aa
MODEL_HOST="<model-host-path>"
CONTAINER=glm52-full
PORT=8000

NODE_ROLE="<head-or-worker>"
case "$NODE_ROLE" in
  head)
    NODE_IP=$HEAD_IP
    PEER_IP=$WORKER_IP
    ;;
  worker)
    NODE_IP=$WORKER_IP
    PEER_IP=$HEAD_IP
    ;;
  *)
    echo "NODE_ROLE must be head or worker" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if nmcli -t -f NAME connection show | grep -Fxq cx8-rail1; then
  sudo nmcli connection modify cx8-rail1 \
    connection.interface-name "$RAIL_IFACE" connection.autoconnect yes \
    ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" ipv4.never-default yes \
    ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
else
  sudo nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname "$RAIL_IFACE" con-name cx8-rail1 \
    connection.autoconnect yes ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" \
    ipv4.never-default yes ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
fi
sudo nmcli connection up cx8-rail1

test "$(cat /sys/class/net/$RAIL_IFACE/mtu)" = 9000
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Speed: 400000Mb/s'
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Link detected: yes'
ping -I "$RAIL_IFACE" -M do -s 8972 -c 3 "$PEER_IP"

GID_INDEX=$(/usr/sbin/show_gids 2>/dev/null | \
  awk -v d="$RAIL_HCA" -v ip="$NODE_IP" \
    '$1==d && $5==ip && $6=="v2" {gid=$3} END {if (gid!="") print gid}')
test -n "$GID_INDEX"
echo "$RAIL_HCA $NODE_IP GID_INDEX=$GID_INDEX"

for c in port_rcv_errors port_xmit_discards symbol_error link_error_recovery link_downed; do
  test "$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$RAIL_HCA/ports/1/counters/$c)" = 0
done

NTP_HOST=${NTP_HOST:-}
if [ -n "$NTP_HOST" ] && \
   NTP_IP=$(getent ahostsv4 "$NTP_HOST" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}') && \
   [ -n "$NTP_IP" ] && \
   ip route get "$NTP_IP" | head -1 | grep -q 'dev docker0'; then
  MGMT_IFACE=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $5}')
  MGMT_GW=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $3}')
  MGMT_CON=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show "$MGMT_IFACE")
  sudo ip route replace "$NTP_IP/32" via "$MGMT_GW" dev "$MGMT_IFACE"
  nmcli -g ipv4.routes connection show "$MGMT_CON" | grep -q "$NTP_IP/32" || \
    sudo nmcli connection modify "$MGMT_CON" +ipv4.routes "$NTP_IP/32 $MGMT_GW"
  sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd
fi
test "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value)" = yes

if [ "$NODE_ROLE" = head ]; then
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  docker run --rm --network host \
    -v "$MODEL_HOST:/model" --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc \
    "exec hf download '$MODEL_REPO' --revision '$MODEL_REV' --local-dir /model"

  ssh "$WORKER_IP" "mkdir -p '$MODEL_HOST'"
  rsync -aH --info=progress2 --exclude '.cache/' \
    "$MODEL_HOST/" "$WORKER_IP:$MODEL_HOST/"

  LOCAL_MANIFEST=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\n' | sort | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
  REMOTE_MANIFEST=$(ssh "$WORKER_IP" "find '$MODEL_HOST' -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\\n' | sort | sha256sum" | awk '{print $1}')
  test "$LOCAL_MANIFEST" = "$REMOTE_MANIFEST"
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00047.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 47
  echo "MODEL_READY $LOCAL_MANIFEST"
else
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-21600}
  test "$MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -gt 0
  MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
  NEXT_PROGRESS=$SECONDS
  while :; do
    SHARD_COUNT=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 \
      -name 'model-*-of-00047.safetensors' | wc -l)
    if test "$SHARD_COUNT" = 47; then
      break
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE )); then
      echo "Timed out after ${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} seconds waiting for model replication; found $SHARD_COUNT/47 shards in $MODEL_HOST" >&2
      find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*.safetensors' \
        -printf '  %f\n' | sort >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= NEXT_PROGRESS )); then
      echo "Waiting for model replication: $SHARD_COUNT/47 shards"
      NEXT_PROGRESS=$((SECONDS + 60))
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00047.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 47
  echo "MODEL_READY"
fi

runtime.label: Container (ARM64)
runtime.setup_instructions: Use Bash and replace every placeholder. Set `NTP_HOST` only when the NTP route needs correction. Start it on the worker with `NODE_ROLE=worker`; the worker waits up to six hours for the replicated checkpoint unless `MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` is overridden. Then run it on the head with `NODE_ROLE=head`; the head downloads and replicates the checkpoint. Passwordless SSH to the worker RoCE address is required.
runtime.setup_command:
set -euo pipefail

HEAD_IP="<head-roce-ip>"
WORKER_IP="<worker-roce-ip>"
RAIL_IFACE="<roce-interface>"
RAIL_HCA="<roce-hca>"

IMG=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0-aarch64
MODEL_REPO=nvidia/GLM-5.3-NVFP4
MODEL_REV=e3b8f9f2fad29727dfa95e766c5cac18ea1414bf
MODEL_HOST="<model-host-path>"
CONTAINER=glm53-full
PORT=8000

NODE_ROLE="<head-or-worker>"
case "$NODE_ROLE" in
  head)
    NODE_IP=$HEAD_IP
    PEER_IP=$WORKER_IP
    ;;
  worker)
    NODE_IP=$WORKER_IP
    PEER_IP=$HEAD_IP
    ;;
  *)
    echo "NODE_ROLE must be head or worker" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if nmcli -t -f NAME connection show | grep -Fxq cx8-rail1; then
  sudo nmcli connection modify cx8-rail1 \
    connection.interface-name "$RAIL_IFACE" connection.autoconnect yes \
    ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" ipv4.never-default yes \
    ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
else
  sudo nmcli connection add type ethernet ifname "$RAIL_IFACE" con-name cx8-rail1 \
    connection.autoconnect yes ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses "$NODE_IP/24" \
    ipv4.never-default yes ipv6.method disabled 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000
fi
sudo nmcli connection up cx8-rail1

test "$(cat /sys/class/net/$RAIL_IFACE/mtu)" = 9000
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Speed: 400000Mb/s'
ethtool "$RAIL_IFACE" | grep -q 'Link detected: yes'
ping -I "$RAIL_IFACE" -M do -s 8972 -c 3 "$PEER_IP"

GID_INDEX=$(/usr/sbin/show_gids 2>/dev/null | \
  awk -v d="$RAIL_HCA" -v ip="$NODE_IP" \
    '$1==d && $5==ip && $6=="v2" {gid=$3} END {if (gid!="") print gid}')
test -n "$GID_INDEX"
echo "$RAIL_HCA $NODE_IP GID_INDEX=$GID_INDEX"

for c in port_rcv_errors port_xmit_discards symbol_error link_error_recovery link_downed; do
  test "$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$RAIL_HCA/ports/1/counters/$c)" = 0
done

NTP_HOST=${NTP_HOST:-}
if [ -n "$NTP_HOST" ] && \
   NTP_IP=$(getent ahostsv4 "$NTP_HOST" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $1}') && \
   [ -n "$NTP_IP" ] && \
   ip route get "$NTP_IP" | head -1 | grep -q 'dev docker0'; then
  MGMT_IFACE=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $5}')
  MGMT_GW=$(ip route show default | awk 'NR==1 {print $3}')
  MGMT_CON=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show "$MGMT_IFACE")
  sudo ip route replace "$NTP_IP/32" via "$MGMT_GW" dev "$MGMT_IFACE"
  nmcli -g ipv4.routes connection show "$MGMT_CON" | grep -q "$NTP_IP/32" || \
    sudo nmcli connection modify "$MGMT_CON" +ipv4.routes "$NTP_IP/32 $MGMT_GW"
  sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd
fi
test "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value)" = yes

if [ "$NODE_ROLE" = head ]; then
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  docker run --rm --network host \
    -v "$MODEL_HOST:/model" --entrypoint bash "$IMG" -lc \
    "exec hf download '$MODEL_REPO' --revision '$MODEL_REV' --local-dir /model"

  ssh "$WORKER_IP" "mkdir -p '$MODEL_HOST'"
  rsync -aH --info=progress2 --exclude '.cache/' \
    "$MODEL_HOST/" "$WORKER_IP:$MODEL_HOST/"

  LOCAL_MANIFEST=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\n' | sort | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
  REMOTE_MANIFEST=$(ssh "$WORKER_IP" "find '$MODEL_HOST' -path '*/.cache' -prune -o \
    -type f -printf '%P %s\\n' | sort | sha256sum" | awk '{print $1}')
  test "$LOCAL_MANIFEST" = "$REMOTE_MANIFEST"
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00050.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 50
  python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('$MODEL_HOST/config.json')); assert c['architectures']==['GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM']; assert c['quantization_config']['quant_algo']=='MIXED_PRECISION'; print('CONFIG_OK')"
  echo "MODEL_READY $LOCAL_MANIFEST"
else
  mkdir -p "$MODEL_HOST"
  MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-21600}
  test "$MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" -gt 0
  MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
  NEXT_PROGRESS=$SECONDS
  while :; do
    SHARD_COUNT=$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 \
      -name 'model-*-of-00050.safetensors' | wc -l)
    if test "$SHARD_COUNT" = 50; then
      break
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= MODEL_WAIT_DEADLINE )); then
      echo "Timed out after ${MODEL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} seconds waiting for model replication; found $SHARD_COUNT/50 shards in $MODEL_HOST" >&2
      find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*.safetensors' \
        -printf '  %f\n' | sort >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if (( SECONDS >= NEXT_PROGRESS )); then
      echo "Waiting for model replication: $SHARD_COUNT/50 shards"
      NEXT_PROGRESS=$((SECONDS + 60))
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  test "$(find "$MODEL_HOST" -maxdepth 1 -name 'model-*-of-00050.safetensors' | wc -l)" = 50
  echo "MODEL_READY"
fi
